parameters.name: DtsInstanceId
parameters.description: The migration, synchronization, or subscribe instance ID.

parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description:
The ID of the data migration, synchronization, or change tracking task.

> You can call the [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) operation to query the task ID.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region in which the DTS instance resides. For more information, see [List of supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: SynchronizationDirection
parameters.description:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:

- **Forward**: forward.
- **Reverse**: reverse.

> - The default value is **Forward**.
- You can set this parameter to **Reverse** to suspend the reverse synchronization link only if the topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way synchronization.

parameters.name: ZeroEtlJob
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the node is a seamless integration (Zero-ETL) node. Valid values:

- **false**: no.
- **true**: yes.
